rationale: With only 4 minutes until close and mandatory market liquidation, the risk/reward is unfavorable — any position opened now faces forced close at market, exposing to slippage on a small-float stock trading at 96% of its daily range near the high. The 1-minute candles show extremely tight, low-volume consolidation with no directional momentum to exploit in the remaining time. The account is already down on the day, making a speculative end-of-session trade on a volatile name inadvisable.
